plan.title: Live RFQ Extend Time Without Selection

steps.note: Open the API-prepared live RFQ summary; prepared-state rules require this to be the first step.
Apply the required eRFX project configuration for the case.
Apply the required live-submission withdrawal configuration.
Navigate to the RFQ Responses tab where the Settings menu is available.
Open the Increase Event Time dialog for the RFQ stage.
Submit the dialog without changing or selecting a duration option.
Verify the dialog remains open after the unselected submission.
Verify no visible error, server error, crash, or malformed content appeared.
